title: CouncilSpec
description: Typed, validated specification for a /council run. Authored from _USER-PROMPTS.md (Read-tool numbering): Phase 2C lines 10746-10768 (CouncilSpec configurables), Phase 7A lines 10915-10946 (full runtime vocabulary + the six required executable stopping examples at 10937-10942), and 'Council workflow - required production behavior' lines 11172-11244 (production behavior, presets, anti-failure detection). Every enum below is traceable to one of those lines; see x-spec-line on each block.

schema_version.description: CouncilSpec contract version. Major version 1 only for this schema.

extends_preset.description: Presets are editable (spec 11200-11225): a spec MAY declare the preset it was forked from.

lineage.description: Source blueprint/preset lineage; fusions must stay decomposable (spec 11170).

evidence_outranks_votes.description: Spec 11198: 'Agreement is not proof; evidence gates outrank popularity.'

mode.description: Spec 11176: explicit, automatic, and mixed participant selection.

explain_choices.description: Spec 10765: auto-composed council must explain every choice and allow owner override.

role_templates.description: Spec 11178: role templates and custom roles.

role_name.description: Role templates (spec 11178) plus a custom: escape hatch.

subcouncils.description: Recursive: a subcouncil IS a CouncilSpec (spec 10926 nested subcouncil / council-of-councils, 11193).

divergence_before_convergence.description: Spec 11184: mandatory divergence before convergence when configured.

required_before_decision.description: Spec 11198: 'stop only after an executable test settles the dispute.'

exit_when.description: Per-stage stopping expression; same composable grammar as the council-level rule.

dedup.description: Anti-gaming: spec 11236-11237 (idea-count gaming through trivial variants, duplicates passing as novelty).

weights.description: participant_id -> weight. Only meaningful for weighted/bayesian methods.

reject_evidence_free_majority.description: Spec 11233: vote counting without evidence must be detected.

fast_unanimity_is_suspicious.description: Spec 10944 / 11229: instant unanimity without independent reasoning must trigger a response.

source_expression.description: Human-authored form, e.g. 'unique_ideas >= 100 AND completeness_score >= 0.90'. MUST parse to the same tree as `expression` (enforced by the reference validator rule SEM-001, not by JSON Schema).

minimum_deliberation.description: Floors that must be satisfied BEFORE the stopping expression may fire.

hard_caps.description: Unconditional termination guards; firing one yields outcome no_decision or conditional_decision.

stop_expression.description: Composable boolean stopping expression. AND = all_of, OR = any_of, NOT = not, plus weighted logic (spec 10760 ANY/ALL/weighted, 10931 AND/OR/NOT).

stop_leaf.description: A typed metric comparison. The metric name determines the legal operators and the legal value type - the four branches have disjoint metric name sets, so exactly one can match.

stop_leaf_custom.description: Extension escape hatch. A custom metric MUST declare its value type so the evaluator stays typed.

producer.description: What computes this metric (tool, hook, or experiment id).

conditional_decision_requires.description: Conditions that must later be met for a conditional decision to become final.

receipt_schema.description: Path/URI of the receipt schema the run must emit against. Deliberately a documented reference STRING, not a resolved $ref, because the two candidate paths disagree: platform/schema/receipt.schema.json EXISTS (built by the sibling Phase-4 receipt unit, $id file:///C:/Users/Prekzursil/source/ast-integrate/platform/schema/receipt.schema.json), while every work-unit output_schema in command-center/WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json still points at command-center/schema/receipt.schema.json, which does NOT exist. Resolving this to a $ref before the two paths are reconciled would hard-fail every council spec.
